architecture.mechanism: Nonlinear adaptive control using adaptive road observers to suppress vertical and angular vibrations without measuring input disturbances.
architecture.intervention: Implement a nonlinear adaptive control algorithm in the engine control unit that utilizes an adaptive observer to estimate unmeasured throttle body airflow disturbances and commands the electronic throttle actuator to counteract induced idle vibrations, eliminating the need for additional vibration sensors.
architecture.expected_effect: Suppression of engine idle vibration and stabilization of throttle position to prevent uncommanded acceleration loss while maintaining occupant safety under traffic conditions without triggering dashboard warnings.
architecture.falsification_test: Conduct hardware-in-the-loop simulation comparing root mean square values of engine speed fluctuation and throttle position error between the proposed adaptive observer system and a baseline passive system under simulated unmeasured air intake disturbance profiles.
